text:
rachel (acct exec): Quick ask — CardioConnect (vendor/reseller-led) requesting a hybrid concession: 50% off inference + a $10k infra credit for a 6-week pilot. They claim multi-hospital rollout if POC passes. Can finance fast-track? :eyes:
leo (finance ops): Hybrid discounts are tricky. Need the pilot list $ amounts, how infra credit applies (to Dedicated infra or cloud credits), and who books revenue. Also need GL mapping for both concession legs.
maya (revops): Also confirm whether reseller takes a revshare or if vendor is absorbing margin. If vendor is providing infra credit, is that reimbursed to Redwood or is it a pass-through? We need written vendor commitment to avoid messy reconciliations.
rachel (acct exec): Pilot est: 2.4M tokens + 150 GPU-hours. List inference = ~$72k, infra list = ~$30k, total ~$102k. Proposal: 50% off inference (~$36k concession) + vendor-provided $10k infra credit applied to infra charges. Net customer pays ~$56k. Vendor (CardioConnect) will reimburse infra credit to Redwood after signed reseller addendum.
leo (finance ops): Reimbursement promise needs contract language and schedule. For now, finance treats the $10k as contingent vendor-funded credit; until reimbursement received, mark concession as a payable/contra revenue item (GL: 5360) and set a hold in revenue ops. Also request vendor invoice terms.
oliver (head of finance): Policy: internal non-escalated approval up to 45% for hosted pilots. Anything >=45% or concessions >$25k need VP signoff. This request is ~50% + $10k credit -> requires VP. However we can provisionally approve a staged approach: 40% off inference, require vendor to pre-sign reimbursement addendum, require $5k non-refundable onboarding from customer, a hard pilot credit cap of $30k, and LOI with conversion KPI. If vendor confirms prepay for infra credit, finance can fast-track to VP review.
hana (legal): We need: 1) reseller/vendor addendum committing to reimbursing infra credit, 2) LOI from end customer, 3) SOW that limits pilot scope and data handling, plus BAAs if PHI. Legal turnaround 72hrs. Include indemnity carveouts for vendor reimbursements.
rachel (acct exec): Vendor balks at reimbursing upfront but will sign a 30-day reimbursement invoice after pilot. They won't prepay. They want us to net settle.
maya (revops): If reimbursement is post-pilot, we must set credit hold and require vendor invoice within 30 days or else Redwood absorbs the infra credit. That's risky. Recommend vendor pre-authorization or escrow.
leo (finance ops): To reduce risk: require 1) vendor signed addendum, 2) vendor invoice due within 30d of pilot end, and 3) finance reserve of $10k against vendor receivable. Also require deal desk ticket and GL codes: inference concession GL=5365, infra credit reserve GL=2380 (receivable reserve).
oliver (head of finance): Ok: escalate to VP for final signoff. For the thread, conditions to recommend VP approval: 40% off inference (not 50), $10k vendor credit allowed only if vendor signs reimbursement addendum and invoice terms, $5k non-refundable onboarding fee, pilot cap $30k, LOI + SOW + BAAs if needed. VP approval required to exceed any of these.
hana (legal): I'll draft vendor addendum template and SOW checklist. Need contact person and vendor legal email.
rachel (acct exec): I'll get vendor to review addendum and ask customer for LOI today. Tagging @dealbot to create the ticket.
dealbot: /dealdesk create customer=CardioConnect pilot_type=hybrid pilot_discount_request=50% vendor_infra_credit=10000 proposed_counter=40% pilot_cap=30000 onboarding_fee=5000 notes="vendor reimbursement required, potential multi-hospital rollout"
financebot: Checklist for final approval: 1) Deal desk URL, 2) Signed LOI (pdf), 3) Vendor addendum & vendor invoice terms (pdf), 4) SOW with scope & data controls, 5) Confirm GL codes. Finance will hold approval pending VP review given concession size.
vendor-bot: vendor-email-request sent to legal@cardioconnect.com for addendum review.
leo (finance ops): I'll prep the concession memo and the GL reserve entry once docs are in. Tag me in ticket.
rachel (acct exec): Thanks all — looping vendor and customer now. Will update thread when LOI and addendum are signed. :thumbsup:
